request.summary: Reduce the ontology explainer's jargon while preserving its technical meaning and authority boundaries.
request.intent: Make the first visible layer understandable to a beginner and keep formal vocabulary available only when requested.

outputs: one friendly-name plus direct-explanation card for every node
friendly graph, relation, sequence, view, and known-gap labels
validation: Standard mode used one proposal track and two reduction rounds
a native Proposer rewrote 22 nodes and four lanes
the parent Balancer repaired unnatural action labels and visible technical leakage
direct explanations passed the avoidable-jargon scan
technical names and formal definitions remained available through collapsed details
closure recomposes friendly copy into the unchanged canonical ontology records
execution.notes: The optimization point is one friendly name, one direct explanation, and one optional technical record. Examples and comparisons remain optional lenses rather than substitutes for direct meaning.
